violet: Quick micro-sprint: we need ultra-compact hero + 1-line subhead variants for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing cards, one social-safe benchmark teaser (no raw numbers), and a clean webinar lead-routing map. 24h turnaround pls.

dan: Tone props: Hosted = snappy PLG, Dedicated = pragmatic/results, Private = formal & trust. Keep CTAs 1-3 words. No long paragraphs.

kyla: Draft heroes + subheads + CTAs (compact)
- Hosted: "Start with Hosted"  "Prototype quickly. Ship confidently."  "Start free"
- Dedicated: "Reserved capacity"  "Throughput that stays steady."  "Reserve"
- Private: "Private deployment"  "VPC, KMS, on-prem options for regulated apps."  "Contact us"

mike: Alternate micro-variants for A/B
- Hosted alt: "Hosted API for builders"  "Spin up models fast."  "Try Hosted"
- Dedicated alt: "Dedicated GPUs"  "SLA-backed latency and throughput."  "Get capacity"
- Private alt: "Run in your network"  "Keep data control & compliance."  "Request demo"

kyla: Social teaser (single line): "Join our webinar for a live demo and independent latency & cost comparisons across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments."

regbot: Calendar: Webinar "Deployment modes: demo + benchmarks" scheduled 2025-05-14 15:00 UTC. Speakers: @violet @kyla @mike :calendar:

dan: HubSpot routing (hand-off snippet, pseudo):
```
form.field: deployment_interest -> values: hosted | dedicated | private
if value == "hosted": set lifecycle = "MQL"; owner = "marketing"; add.hidden(utm_campaign=launch_webinar)
if value == "dedicated": assign.owner = "AE_pool"; tag = "dedicated_lead"; notify = "ae-team@redwood.com"
if value == "private": assign.owner = "Enterprise_SDR"; priority = "high"; notify = "sales-enterprise@redwood.com"
```
Please convert to HubSpot workflow and post workflow IDs here.

violet: Good work. Kyla  pick the primary per mode (use first set unless you prefer alt) and put both A/B variants in the draft doc. Mike  format the social teaser for LinkedIn/X and include a short alt for ad copy. Dan  follow up with ops for the workflows. Back in 24h. Thanks :rocket:
